strategies.name: vwap_break_and_pullback_long
strategies.entry_summary: Go long only after a penny stock opens/starts weak below VWAP, then breaks above VWAP with strong volume and an obvious string of green candles. Enter on the subsequent pullback/dip buy into VWAP support (or nearby obvious support like a whole-dollar level) to catch the first bounce.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage the trade as a scalp: sell into the bounce upward after VWAP holds as support rather than buying/holding at highs. The speaker frames exits as scalping out / riding the bounce for profit, but does not teach a more detailed mechanical stop/target beyond using the pullback-to-support risk/rewar

variants.variant_label: VWAP pullback long after obvious break with volume
variants.timeframe_note: Intraday, typically after the opening bell; examples around 10:00 and 11:00-11:30 market time
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for break above VWAP plus strong volume and multiple green candles, then buy the pullback as VWAP holds support
variants.target_note: Scalp out into the bounce / upward momentum after support holds
variants.transcript_quote: when the stock actually breaks above the v-wop after being below it at the opening bell i'm looking to buy on those pull backs looking for the v-wap[p

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one long-only VWAP reclaim/pullback scalp across multiple examples; the examples are compatible variants of the same skeleton, not separate strategies. Exit logic is only lightly specified as scalping/riding the bounce, so no opposite or additional setup is promoted.
